data.case_title: Health insurance contribution increase – Musterquell Krankenkasse
data.title: Notice of increased health and long-term care insurance contributions from 1 January 2027
data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that, as a voluntarily insured member, her monthly health and long-term care insurance contribution will rise to €318.46 from 1 January 2027, because of a new supplementary contribution rate and the income shown in her 2025 tax assessment.
data.explanation: Your statutory health insurer is raising your monthly contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027, because its supplementary contribution rate changed and based on the income reported in your 2025 tax assessment. The amount will continue to be debited automatically on the 15th of the following month. If you disagree with the new amount, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Krankenkasse; the app will show you the deadline. If you do nothing, the new amount simply applies. Since this is a formal decision (Bescheid), consider seeking advice if you think the calculation is wrong.
